verdict.rationale: Evidence only hints at filtering capability via 'keyword filtering' combined with vector search (weaviate-gh-4) and mentions of inverted indexes for structured data (weaviate-probe-1), but there is no documentation addressing how structured metadata filters interact with vector search to preserve recall or latency. missing for 10: explicit docs on pre-filtering/post-filtering strategy, benchmarks or claims about recall/latency impact of combined filter+vector queries, and independent corroboration of filter performance.
